blocked_sentences: This creature can't be blocked except by three or more creatures.

needs.what: a minimum-blockers field on the block_restriction static (e.g. `min_blockers: 3` with `affects: {self_only: true}`), checked in combat.blocks_valid on the complete declaration: an attacker it affects may be blocked by zero creatures or by at least N, generalising menace's hard-coded two
needs.why_existing_wont_do: block_restriction carries `blockers` (a per-blocker filter), `max_blockers` (an upper cap, Challenger Troll) and `require_all` (Tromokratis), but no lower bound; the menace keyword is the only minimum and it is fixed at two, so granting menace would let two creatures block it
